baselines.B1_fixed_time: the same endpoint evaluated once at a single predeclared n, no wake weight
baselines.B2_naive_repeated_look: B1 recomputed at every t and reported at the first clearing t; invalid, included to be shown failing
baselines.B3_anytime_valid: the wake-and-atom construction in this contract
baselines.primary_metric: fraction of null replicates in which the procedure ever declares; target at most delta for B1 and B3
baselines.secondary_metric: first index at which the reported endpoint falls below the train-split base-rate Brier score, and endpoint width at final n
baselines.win_condition: B3 null exceedance at most delta while B2 exceeds it, and B3 endpoint at final n within a factor stated in the receipt of the B1 single-look endpoint

calibration.use: freeze the posterior rho; never monitored

train.use: constant baseline probability and the null-replicate base rate

dataset.ingested_tab_hazard: plain /api/access/datafile/{id} returns a Dataverse-regenerated TSV whose bytes do not match the published MD5; the metadata filesize field reports that regenerated size. Only ?format=original reproduces the pinned digest.
dataset.title: GJP Data

eligibility_after_temporal_amendment.complete_case_rule: both first-week-mean and final-consensus-median are defined from at least one eligible option-a forecast row

failure_cases: vacuity at n = 175: the confidence log term may put the endpoint above the base-rate Brier score; predeclared, and no re-tuning of delta, wake grid, catalog, or split is permitted in response
the bounded quantity is posterior-averaged empirical Brier risk on the encountered suffix, not future, stationary, population, or deployment risk
the 382 resolved binaries are a selected subset of GJP questions; the receipt records inclusion and exclusion counts

the source date_suspend can follow date_closed and forecast rows can predate date_start; amendment 2026-08-28 therefore enforces the conservative question window from date_start through the earlier of suspension and closure
the consensus models read a crowd shaped by the tournament's own feedback; the bound stays valid for the encountered suffix but licenses no favorable reading of catalog skill
reporting a wake outside the declared grid spends confidence that was never allocated

leakage_tests.fails_when: any consumed timestamp lies outside date_start <= timestamp < effective_cutoff = min(date_suspend, start-of-date_closed)
the oracle-leak model, defined from the outcome column, is scored instead of refused at ingestion
a first-week reducer consumes any row at or after effective_cutoff, indicating the suspension-or-closure clamp is not applied
empirical suffix risk differs across permutations in any rational digit
the B3 exceedance rate over the null replicates is above delta

lean_binding.open_obligation: no Lean score : iota -> TrajectoryScore Z and path x : Nat -> Z realizing the monitored stream exists, and no lemma proves the two exact rationals equal the corresponding Lean expressions at that score and x

receipt_field_to_lean_object.boundary_interval.upper: upper bound on finiteTrajectorySleepingSuffixVarianceGeometricTiltBoundary prior posterior score delta a w n x
receipt_field_to_lean_object.kl_interval.upper: upper bound on klDiv posterior prior
receipt_field_to_lean_object.prior_and_posterior: prior posterior : iota -> Real with IsFullSupportPMF and IsPMF
receipt_field_to_lean_object.tilt_atom: a with hypothesis a in Finset.range (finiteTrajectorySleepingSuffixVarianceMaxIndex w n + 1)
receipt_field_to_lean_object.wake: w with w <= n and 4 <= n - w

models.definition: train-split outcome frequency, quantized; read at run time
row-level unweighted mean of all recognized option-a forecast event types on [date_start, min(date_start + 7 days, effective_cutoff))
median over users of each user's last emitted option-a value satisfying date_start <= timestamp < effective_cutoff; fcast_type 4 is retained as its emitted last-standing probability
logit extremization of final-consensus-median, exponent 2, clipped to [1/100, 99/100]

nonclaims: prospective protocol only; no stream, receipt, or result exists at this commit
the monitored quantity is encountered conditional suffix risk, not future, stationary, population, or deployment risk
no Lean theorem currently consumes any quantity named here; the instantiation obligation is open
a catalog posterior over four declared models is not coin betting and is not a parameter-free master
the vacuity risk at this sample size is real and is predeclared, not a result to be tuned away

observation_unit.rejected_alternative: question-day pairs reuse one outcome across many predictions and destroy the one-step-ahead structure the monitor assumes
observation_unit.selection: n_opts == 2 and outcome in {a, b} and q_status == closed

posterior_rule.certified_object: the deterministic rational simplex quantization of the ideal Gibbs posterior
posterior_rule.ideal_formula: rho_ideal(m) proportional to pi(m) * exp(-n_cal * empiricalBrier_cal(m))
posterior_rule.quantization_rule: largest-remainder method: floor each ideal weight times the denominator, then allocate remaining units by descending fractional remainder with model-id ascending ties

prediction_before_outcome.date_closed_interpretation: midnight at the start of the recorded date in the same naive source-clock representation; no timezone conversion
prediction_before_outcome.rule: every consumed forecast timestamp satisfies date_start <= timestamp < effective_cutoff

survey_forecast_event_types.policy: include every recognized event type and fail closed on any other code

preregistration_disclosure.forecast_file_inspection: header line and first three data rows of survey_fcasts.yr1.tab

protocol_amendments.data_access_before_amendment: structural timestamp audit only; no forecast-to-outcome score, posterior, boundary, or result was computed
protocol_amendments.discovery: 200 of 382 selected questions have date_closed earlier than date_suspend; 3987 option-a forecast rows fall at or after date_closed but before date_suspend; 5442 selected option-a rows predate date_start; IFPs 5008-0 and 5009-0 have no legal forecast after applying the amended window
protocol_amendments.reason: the original date_suspend-only rule did not establish that every input was emitted while the question was open

protocol_amendments.data_access_before_amendment: structural and implementation audit only; no monitor score, boundary, or result was computed
protocol_amendments.discovery: the ideal exponential-weights posterior is transcendental while the replay contract requires an exact rational theorem input
protocol_amendments.reason: the original protocol specified no deterministic map from the ideal Gibbs weights to an exact probability mass function
protocol_amendments.replacement_rule: compute ideal weights with Decimal precision 80 and ROUND_HALF_EVEN, then quantize to the 10^15 simplex by the largest-remainder rule with model-id ties

quantization.validity_argument: reported endpoint = Rhat + (KLup + LOGup + PSIup * V) / ((n - w) * lambda); every numerator summand is at least its real counterpart, using V >= 0 from finiteTrajectoryPosteriorSuffixPredictorQuadraticVariation_mem_Icc for the PSIup * V term; the denominator is exact and strictly positive and Rhat is exact, so the reported endpoint is at least the real geometric-tilt boundary at that atom
